title: USDJPY M30 ATR Volatility Spike Gate Test
research_question: Does activating an ATR volatility spike filter (InpUseAtrFilter=true, InpMaxAtrPips=30.0) on USDJPY M30 eliminate high-volatility stop-out clusters observed during 2025 validation (EXP-0039), shifting 2025 validation net profit toward breakeven or profitability (>= $0.00) while preserving 2020-2024 training gains (EXP-0038, +$514.80) with drawdown <= 8.0%?
hypothesis: Because USDJPY experienced extreme volatility expansion during 2025 Bank of Japan monetary policy shifts, market noise repeatedly clipped the fixed 20-pip stop loss, resulting in 10 losses out of 12 trades in EXP-0039. Filtering entries when M30 ATR(14) exceeds 30.0 pips will bypass anomalous volatility spikes without degrading standard Fibonacci pullback setups, significantly improving out-of-sample win rate and net payoff.

facts: In EXP-0038 on USDJPY M30 with Asian session enabled, training (2020-2024) achieved +$514.80 net profit, PF 1.35, 49 trades, and 6.96% drawdown.
In EXP-0039 evaluating the identical candidate across 2025 validation, performance collapsed to -$804.63 net profit, PF 0.18, 12 trades, and 10 losses (83.33% loss rate) with 9.62% equity drawdown.
In EXP-0039, 9 consecutive losses occurred as USDJPY traded in wide-range daily regimes exceeding 150-250 pips, overwhelming the 20-pip stop loss buffer.
The uncalibrated baseline EXP-0030 without Asian session lost -$849.34 in training, proving that session liquidity and volatility calibration are critical on USDJPY.
inferences: USDJPY Fibonacci setups remain structurally valid during normal volatility conditions, as demonstrated by the +$514.80 gain in 2020-2024.
Catastrophic 2025 losses were concentrated during extreme volatility spikes where bar ranges exceed the stop-loss buffer.
An ATR volatility gate (InpUseAtrFilter=true, InpMaxAtrPips=30.0) will filter entries during these high-risk volatility environments, eliminating loss clusters while keeping the core strategy intact.
evidence: EXP-0039 total_trades=12, total_net_profit=-804.63, profit_factor=0.18, loss_trades=10, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=9.62

independent_variables.name: InpUseAtrFilter
independent_variables.rationale: Activate ATR volatility filter to block entries when M30 volatility exceeds 30.0 pips.

assumptions: USDJPY 2025 losses were primarily caused by entry during high-volatility whip-saw periods.
Normal volatility regimes (ATR <= 30 pips) retain profitable Fibonacci pullbacks.
expected_observations: 2020-2024 Training retains profitability (> $300.00 net profit, PF >= 1.20, Max DD <= 8.0%).
2025 Validation reduces loss trades significantly, eliminating consecutive stop-outs during BoJ volatility spikes.
falsification_conditions: Trade frequency drops below 10 trades across the 5-year training period.
2025 Validation net loss remains severe (< -$500.00) or win rate remains < 35.0%.
